description: Editorial synchronization preset. Merge anti_desync_locks and scene_defaults into manifest. Not automatically loaded. Boolean legacy locks are descriptive, not runtime switches.

hard_frame_lock.description: Target fps and duration checked per segment; exact frame-count lock not verified.

apad_atrim_padding.description: Pad and trim audio to effective scene duration.

never_stretch_voiceover.description: No voice tempo stretching in scene audio chain.

voiceover_duration_protection.description: Effective duration at least probed voice duration plus voice_start and sentence padding when probe succeeds.

zero_speech_overlap.description: Sequential segment concat, no audio crossfade; actual sync requires output QC.

preview_duration_check.reference: actual master duration or explicit preview limit

exact_master_duration_check.description: Effective duration may exceed planned duration; exact frame and speech alignment require end-to-end verification.
